title: The first box, lettered
logline: Box 21's lid, close, and a hand with a marker finishing the 1 of 21 — the first private box lettered, in September, eight months of pages under it. The hand is the most of him this page allows.

panels.composition: Close on a cardboard box lid with a hand holding a marker finishing the second digit of a two-digit number, the marker's line still wet, the box full of pages.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a cardboard box lid with a man's hand holding a marker finishing the second digit of a number in wet black ink, the box beneath full of pages, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
